name: Traffic Crashes - Vision Zero Chicago Traffic Fatalities

columns.name: Person_ID
columns.description: Unique ID linking this record to the PERSON table in eCrash

columns.name: Crash_Date
columns.description: Date and time of crash on police report

columns.name: Crash_Location
columns.description: Estimated address of crash based on crash report

columns.name: Victim
columns.description: Activity classification of victim: CYCLIST / DRIVER / MOTORCYCLIST / PASSENGER / PEDESTRIAN

columns.name: Crash_Circumstances
columns.description: Brief description of the circumstances involved in the fatal crash. This column was added in 2024.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The crash location in a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis.

columns.name: Zip Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Zip Codes' (6mkv-f3dw) the point in column 'geocoded_column' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
